keyVerseDR: "Blessed art thou among women and blessed is the fruit of thy womb." (Lk 1:42)

level1.title: Mary Visits Elizabeth
level1.story: Mary went to visit Elizabeth. Elizabeth's baby, John, jumped for joy! Elizabeth said, "Blessed are you, Mary!"
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: Who can you visit or call?
level1.prayer: Mary, help me bring Jesus to others. Amen.

activity.title: Advent wreath
activity.intro: Fourth week of Advent! Color all four candles.

level2.title: The Visitation
level2.story: Mary rose up and went with haste into the hill country, to a city of Judah. She entered the house of Zechariah and greeted Elizabeth. When Elizabeth heard Mary's greeting, the baby leaped in her womb, and she was filled with the Holy Spirit. Elizabeth cried out, "Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb." She said, "Blessed art thou that hast believed."
level2.keyLine: Blessed art thou among women and blessed is the fruit of thy womb.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Which words of the Hail Mary come from Elizabeth?
actions: Help a pregnant mom or family
level2.prayer: Mary, help me carry Jesus to others. Amen.

activity.title: Who am I?
clues: My baby leaped for joy when Mary greeted me.
I said, Blessed art thou among women.
